Verdict: NO_GO

The financial analysis indicates a negative NPV of -10,000 USD and an undefined IRR, meaning the project cannot generate sufficient returns under the current assumptions. Additionally, critical risks such as regulatory licensing complexity, volatile supply of PET/HDPE waste, and uncertain demand for recycled pellets have no robust mitigation plans in place. These factors collectively render the project infeasible at this stage.

Risk summary

Negative NPV and undefined IRR indicating poor financial viability
Regulatory licensing and permitting complexity (SASO, EPA)
Volatile supply chain for PET/HDPE waste
Uncertain and potentially low demand for recycled pellets
Lack of clear mitigation strategies for market price fluctuations of virgin plastic
